assets.prompt: Create a single high-resolution landscape 16:9 cinematic still for an internal editorial documentary visual-language test, not an advertisement and not evidence. Scene: one modest, specific independent inn checkout desk in late-morning natural window light, lived-in warm wood, cream linen, lightly worn brass details. Camera is locked, restrained 40mm documentary lens, waist/chest-level close observational framing, shallow but natural depth of field, soft contrast, no luxury gloss. The central recurring object is a distinctive physical brass hotel key tag resting at the center of the wooden desk, landscape-oriented rounded rectangle with one clipped/chamfered corner, a single circular hole near the left end, and one fine vertical scratch near the right third. A guest hand in a dark olive wool sleeve enters from frame left and is just finishing placing the tag down. An operator hand in a cream cotton shirt and deep navy apron enters from frame right and is receiving it. Hands anatomically plausible; partial bodies only; no prominent or identifiable faces. Leave the key tag clearly visible around the center region for a later match cut, with the desk running horizontally. No readable text anywhere, no logo, no screen, no reservation document, no receipt, no interface, no personal data, no platform branding, no decorative props competing for attention. Warm cream, ink, navy, muted wood, and authentic brass palette. Editorial documentary illustration with natural photographic texture, restrained and plausible.
